paite: Manasseh in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawm-le-nih ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nga vai ahawm hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Manasseh / (2 Kum 21.1-9)

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou, Israel suante ma a TOUPA'N adelhkhiak Pathian thei lou namte'n thilkihhuaitak ahih bang uh ama'n leng ahih zel hi.
Apa Hezekiah in ahihchip nung mun sangte abawlhoih a, Baalte a ding in maitam abawl a, Asherah limte abawl a, van a om tengteng abia a, a-nna uh asem hi.
"Jerusalem ah tangtawn in ka min a-om ding," TOUPA'N achihna TOUPA' inn ah maitamte abawl hi.
TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nih ah van a om tengteng a ding in maitamte abawl hi.
Phaizang ah Hinnom tapa mei ah atate alutsak a; aisante aching a, bumte aching a, dawi aisan siam zawlte leh bumsiamte aguai sek a; TOUPA thangpaisak ding in amitmuh ah thil hoih lou ahih hi.

Pathian in David leh atapa Solomon kiang a, "Hiai inn leh Jerusalem a Israel chi tengteng lak a ka tel ah ka min tangtawn in ka omsak ding, achih khitsa Pathian inn ah amah bawl, milim bawltawm akoih hi.

Thu ka piak tengteng leh dan tengteng, dan thuseh, thilhih ding Mosi zang a ka piakte azuih peuhmah uleh api-le-pute uh ka piaksa gam a kipan Israelte khe ka kal suankhesak nawn kei ding," achihna ah.
Manasseh in Judahte leh Jerusalem a mite thil ahihkhialsak a; TOUPA'N Israelte ma a ahihman khitsa namte sang in ahihkhialzaw hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Manasseh leh amite kiang ah thu agen zel a; himahleh alimsak kei uhi.
heading: Manasseh Akisik

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria sepaih heutute asawl a, Manasseh khainiang in akhih ua, kol abunsak ua, Babulon ah apaipihta uhi.
Huchi in mangbangtak a a-om lai in TOUPA a Pathian azong a, api-le-pute Pathian ma ah nakpitak in akiniamkhiak hi.
Akiang ah athum a, hehpih angen a, angetna angaihkhiaksak a, Jerusalem ah agam ah apai nawnta hi.

Huai nung in David kho polam ah Gihon tumlam pang phaizang ah ngasa kongkhak lutna pha in kulh abawl a, Ophel umsuak in sangpi in adingsak a: Judah khua kulh nei tengteng ah heutu hangsan taktak akoih hi.
Gamdang pathiante leh milimte, TOUPA' inn a kipan apaimang a, tang a TOUPA' inn leh Jerusalem a maitam abawl tengteng khua a kipan apaikhe vek uhi.
TOUPA maitam abawl a, lemna thillat kithoihnate, kipahthu gennate alan a, Judahte bel TOUPA Israel' Pathian nasem ding in thu apia hi.
Mipite mun sang ah akithoih lailai ua; himahleh TOUPA a Pathian uh kiang ah kithoih ahi zawta hi.
Manasseh tanchin dang tengteng, a Pathian kiang a athum thute, TOUPA Israel' Pathian min a zawlnei in akiang a thu agente uh ngai dih, Israel kumpipate tanchin lak ah atuang hi.
heading: Manasseh Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna

paite: Athumnate, Pathian in ahehpihna leh akiniamkhiak ma in agitlouhna tengteng, mun sang abawl a, Asher leh milim bawltawm a bawlkhiakna mun tengteng leng, ngai dih, Hozai tanchin gelhna bu ah atuang vek hi.
Huchi in Manasseh bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, ama inn ah avui ua; atapa Ammon in asik in vai ahawmta hi.
Ammon in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nih ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum nih vai ahawm hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ammon

paite: Apa Manasseh hih mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; apa Manasseh in abawl milim bawltawm tengteng kiang ah Ammon akithoih a, a-nna asem hi.
Apa Manasseh kiniamkhiak bang in TOUPA ma ah akiniamkhiak kei a, Ammon agilou semsem hi.
Huchi in a sikhate'n asawm ua, ama inn ah athat uhi.
Himahleh kumpipa Ammon kalh a phialguk sawm mi tengteng mipi'n athat vek nawn ua; asik a kumpipa hi ding in mipite'n atapa Josiah abawlta uhi.
